raw_segments.text: Sonya fell upon her, flung her arms about her, and remained motionless with her head
pressed to the dead woman's wasted bosom. Polinka threw herself at her mother's feet,
kissing them and weeping violently. Though Kalia and Lita did not understand what had
happened, they had a feeling that it was something terrible. They put their hands on each other's
little shoulders, stared straight at one another and both at once opened their mouths and began
screaming. They were both still in their fancy dress,
one in a turban, the other in the cap with the ostrich feather.
